control_970.controlData:
Quota Spreading

Please select a Plan Year, Scenario and Territory Model to view the corresponding spread patterns.

control_976.controlData:
Spread Patterns

Click on a row in the table below to edit a spread pattern for a given territory.  A new spread pattern can be assigned to a territory using the Add Spread Pattern button or copied from an existing spread pattern using the Copy Spread Pattern button.  One or more spread patterns can also be refreshed based on the forecast using the Refresh From Forecast button.

control_1029.controlData: Select a Territory to copy from and a Territory to copy to.  You cannot copy to a Territory that already exists.

control_1033.xSQL:
insert into quota_spreading (plan_year, scenario, territory_model, territory_name, m01, m02, m03, m04, m05, m06, m07, m08, m09, m10, m11, m12, q1, q2, q3, q4, fy)
select plan_year, scenario, territory_model, :v_to, m01, m02, m03, m04, m05, m06, m07, m08, m09, m10, m11, m12, q1, q2, q3, q4, fy
from quota_spreading
where plan_year = :v_year and scenario = :v_scenario and territory_model = :v_territory_model and territory_name = :v_from

control_1043.xSQL:
delete * from $framework.quota_spreading
where (plan_year = :v_year)
and (scenario = :v_scenario)
and (territory_model = :v_territory_model)
and territory_name in :v_territories;
